ORDINANCE VI OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN SERVICE TRIBUNAL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1978
An Ordinance to amend the Baluchistan Service Tribunal Act, 1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 23rd February, 1978]
No. Legis 1-47/Law/73.--The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 13th
February, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This Ordinate may be
called the Baluchistan Service Tribunal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from 26th February 1977.

Amendment in Baluchistan Act, V of 1974

ORDINANCE VI OF 1978
ORDINANCE VI OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN SERVICE TRIBUNAL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1978
An Ordinance to amend the Baluchistan Service Tribunal Act, 1974
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 23rd February, 1978]
No. Legis 1-47/Law/73.--The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 13th
February, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment in Baluchistan Act, V of 1974.--In the Service
Tribunals Act of 1974 in section 2, for clause (a) the following shall be
substituted, namely;
"(2) Civil Servant means a person who is, or has been a
Civil Servant within the meaning of Baluchistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act
IX of 1974)."
